# kion_billing_source_govcloud (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion BillingSourceGovcloud by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_billing_source_govcloud" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the BillingSourceGovcloud to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `account_creation_enabled` (Boolean)
- `aws_account_number` (String)
- `car_external_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `payer_id` (Number)
- `service_external_id` (String)
